history.units: SELECT token,profile_id,created_in_revision_id,object_name,created_at FROM required_units ORDER BY token
history.mapping: SELECT revision_id,revision_part_id,unit_index,required_unit_token FROM plan_revision_required_units ORDER BY revision_part_id,unit_index
history.progress: SELECT part_id,unit_index,completed,assembled FROM print_progress ORDER BY part_id,unit_index
history.plateRevisions: SELECT * FROM accepted_plate_revisions ORDER BY id
history.plateHeads: SELECT * FROM accepted_plate_heads ORDER BY profile_id
history.plates: SELECT * FROM accepted_plates ORDER BY revision_id,plate_id
history.plateUnits: SELECT * FROM accepted_plate_units ORDER BY revision_id,required_unit_token

state.drafts: SELECT id,state,digest_format,current_required_unit_reconciliation_id,snapshot_digest FROM plan_drafts ORDER BY id
state.parts: SELECT id,draft_id,base_revision_part_id,included,quantity_override,quantity_effective FROM plan_draft_parts ORDER BY id
state.reconciliations: SELECT id AS reconciliation_id,draft_id,actor_id,idempotency_key,result_kind,reconciliation_digest,payload_digest,expected_assignment_count,finalized_at IS NOT NULL AS finalized FROM plan_draft_required_unit_reconciliations ORDER BY id
state.decisions: SELECT reconciliation_id,target_draft_part_id,kind,predecessor_revision_part_id FROM plan_draft_required_unit_decisions ORDER BY reconciliation_id,target_draft_part_id

cases.name: unsafe-retain-completed-split
setup: UPDATE print_progress SET completed=1 WHERE part_id=1 AND unit_index=1
